scope: 8 architecture-aligned consumer shapes; single-consumer module only
aggregation: Per-order rounds pooled for P50/P90; conservative speedup is fastest full-baseline round divided by slowest candidate round. Chunk score sums are not standalone invocation latency.

metadata.baseline: DeepGEMM and existing keys_major fullscore + perquery mask, same Ant selector; numerical gate against DeepGEMM
metadata.scope: single consumer: publication/normalize, all gather/score chunks, fused map/topk; source generation separately measured
metadata.score_only_parts: each score/selector chunk measured after own preparation; sums are derived, not continuous invocation timings
metadata.cache: warm repeated calls, no L2 flush
metadata.peak_scope: all compared variants and independent source resident
